issues.text: The cleanup flow leaves six lines of Error-level debug logging that also dump the entire batch of IDs into the log.
issues.zh: 清理流程留下六行 Error 等級的除錯 log，且會把整批 ID 印進日誌

issues.text: The cleanup background job's ticker was changed from 10 minutes to 1 minute, affecting eight unrelated cleanup jobs.
issues.zh: cleanup 背景工作的 ticker 從 10 分鐘改成 1 分鐘，影響八個與本 PR 無關的清理工作

issues.text: The workaround for the parameter limit only handles SQLite, and branches on the configured batch size instead of the actual number of IDs.
issues.zh: 參數上限的繞道只做了 SQLite，且用設定值而非實際 ID 筆數判斷

issues.text: The SQLite branch builds the IN list via O(n^2) string concatenation.
issues.zh: SQLite 分支用 O(n²) 的字串累加組出 IN 清單

issues.text: The new large-batch test doesn't actually push the annotation deletion path past the parameter limit; it's the annotation_tag path that actually guards against the regression.
issues.zh: 新增的大批次測試沒有讓 annotation 刪除路徑跨過參數上限，實際守住迴歸的是 annotation_tag 路徑

issues.text: t.Cleanup is registered after test data is created, so a failing subtest leaves data behind and contaminates subsequent test cases.
issues.zh: t.Cleanup 註冊在建立測試資料之後，任一子測試失敗就會連鎖污染後續案例

issues.text: The t.Skip message casing is inconsistent with the existing convention in the repo.
issues.zh: t.Skip 訊息大小寫與 repo 內既有慣例不一致

issues.text: The migrator import is placed in a separate import group from the sqlstore import in the same file.
issues.zh: migrator import 放進了子套件分組，與同檔案的 sqlstore import 分開

issues.text: fetchIDs builds the SELECT statement before checking whether condition is empty.
issues.zh: fetchIDs 先組出 SELECT 才檢查 condition 是否為空

open_questions.text: The whole refactor is premised on a single-statement batched subquery deadlocking with concurrent writes on MySQL, but there's no reproducible evidence of this in the branch. Where was this deadlock actually observed?
open_questions.zh: 整個重構的前提是「單敘述批次子查詢在 MySQL 上會與併發寫入互卡」，但這件事在本分支裡沒有任何可重現的憑據。這個 deadlock 是在哪裡觀察到的？

open_questions.text: untilDoneOrCancelled stops when a batch's affected count is 0; under multi-instance concurrent cleanup, could this end a round prematurely and prevent the backlog from converging?
open_questions.zh: untilDoneOrCancelled 以「本批 affected == 0」作為結束條件；在多實例併發清理下，這會不會讓單輪提早結束、使積壓無法收斂？
